info.title: xitter posts API
info.description: Posts, replies, and interactions (likes, bookmarks, reposts).

adminToken.description: Admin principal: an admin-realm user token (admin-panel client, ADMIN_ROLES realm role) or a svc-admin service token carrying an admin role.

post.description: Create a post or reply. `text` is 1-512 chars; `mediaIds` (max 4) must exist, belong to the author and be ready (media internal lookup; non-ready ids 400 with details). Replies are rejected when a block exists between the replier and the parent author in either direction.

delete.description: Soft-delete own post (author only). Deleted posts are hidden everywhere.

get.description: Author's visible posts, newest first (replies included).
Replies to a post in chronological (oldest first) order.

post.description: Bulk visible-post lookup (feed #7 hydration); deleted/missing ids are omitted from the response.
Truncate posts + interactions (reset job); deterministic reseed runs via the seed script.

get.description: Moderation list. Filters: authorId, text (case-insensitive contains), deleted (`true`/`false`; absent = both, tombstones included).
Any post, deleted or not - moderation must see tombstones.

delete.description: Moderation delete. Default soft (`?hard=false`): hidden everywhere, restorable. `?hard=true`: row + interactions gone. Both emit `posts.post.deleted` so feeds drop the post like an author delete. Audit-logged.

post.description: Restore a soft-deleted post. Visible again on every read path; `posts.post.created` re-emitted so feeds re-materialise at the original position.

get.description: Moderation audit trail for posts data (who deleted/restored what, when).
